label: Start on the card
thesis: The filter strip sits above the deck like the listing's. The first card's player box shows the video's thumbnail with a Start button laid over it, so there is one deck and one place to look. Pressing Start removes the thumbnail and button and loads the player, and later cards start from swipes.
risk: Acts matched only on Apple Music or Spotify, or on a YouTube channel with no video, have no thumbnail, so their box is plain dark. Start can be missed when the visitor has just changed a filter and the page reloads.
